digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently drops 480 events (219 STATUS, 181 SIGNATURE, 64 COMMENT, 8 EDIT, 4 VERIFY_COMMANDS, 4 FILE_IMPACT) whose source files were deleted by legacy compaction before 2026-07-07, reverting 214 tickets from closed to in_progress or open

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log replays only surviving event files without detecting missing source events cited in the prior snapshot, so deleted folded events that existed only in the snapshot's compiled_state are permanently lost
fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run mutates the store instead of respecting the dry_run flag, making read-only preview of rebuilds impossible

A store-wide fsck check must report every ticket whose SNAPSHOT cites missing source events before a repair runs, and rebuild must fail closed rather than write a lossy snapshot when source files are absent

fsck repair must restore deleted events from origin/tickets history and complete the event log before rebuilding, since 505 live tickets have snapshots citing missing sources that are recoverable from deletion records
Deleted source events must be recovered as .retired folded files never as live events, with newest-deletion-wins ordering to handle paths deleted multiple times
